title: AINM Protocol - Identity Schema
description: Identity domain types for the AI-Native Messaging Protocol v0.1.0. Covers participant identity records, registration, key rotation, and well-known endpoints. See spec/identity.md.

IdentityRecord.description: The JSON document returned by a provider when an identity is resolved via GET https://{provider}/.well-known/ainm/{name}. See identity.md Section 4.2.

id.description: Full AINM address. MUST match {name}@{provider} from the request URL.

public_key.description: Current Ed25519 public key, base64url-encoded without padding.

server.description: WebSocket endpoint URL for the participant's home server. MUST use wss:// scheme.

type.description: Participant type. The protocol treats both equally; clients MAY adapt UI presentation.

agent_card_url.description: URL to an A2A-compatible Agent Card (JSON). Present when type is 'agent', omitted when type is 'human'.

key_history.description: Array of previous key records, ordered from most recent to oldest. May be empty if never rotated.

RegistrationRequest.description: Request body for POST https://{provider}/.well-known/ainm/register. See identity.md Section 5.2.

name.description: Desired name. MUST conform to identity.md Section 3.2 name rules.

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key, base64url-encoded without padding.

RegistrationResponse.description: Successful registration response (HTTP 201). Returns the full identity record. See identity.md Section 5.3.

KeyRotationRecord.description: A historical key entry in the key_history array. See identity.md Section 6.5.

public_key.description: The historical Ed25519 public key, base64url-encoded without padding.

valid_from.description: RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC) when this key was activated.

valid_until.description: RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC) when this key was replaced.

revocation_reason.description: Reason for rotation. scheduled_rotation = routine, compromised = key exposed, administrative = provider-initiated.

KeyRotationRequest.description: Request body for POST https://{provider}/.well-known/ainm/{name}/rotate. See identity.md Section 6.2.

new_public_key.description: The new Ed25519 public key, base64url-encoded without padding.

proof.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature of the new_public_key string (UTF-8 bytes), signed with the current private key.

WellKnownAINMConfig.description: The .well-known/ainm/server configuration document for server/federation discovery. See transport.md Section 5.2.

server_id.description: Server identifier, typically the domain name.

public_key.description: Server's Ed25519 public key for verifying server-level relay signatures.

relay_endpoint.description: Full URL of the relay endpoint for federation.

tls_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the server's TLS certificate.

IdentityErrorCodes.description: Identity-related JSON-RPC error codes. Range: -32001 to -32007. See identity.md Section 4.6, 5.4, 6.9.

default.name: InvalidName
default.description: Name does not match required format

default.name: InvalidProof
default.description: Key rotation proof signature verification failed
